correctness.rationale: Exact distance-signature complement lemma, a complete reduction of five-landmark sets to pairs of partitions of five labels, and proof that two unused coordinates per axis represent every possible exterior pair. The standalone enumeration checks all 1153 admissible partition pairs and 34 normal-form patterns, all 9 saturation regimes, automorphism orders and formula; independent direct board enumeration agrees at (5,5),(5,6),(6,6). Previously published Theorem 2.5 supplies the minimum size five.

value.rationale: The full list of optimal landmark placements and their closed infinite-family census measure robustness and degeneracy of the already-known minimum-size solution. Five stable and four five-side-only isomorphism types reveal an abrupt structural boundary not implied by the scalar optimum. This is a natural exact graph invariant with a complete structural certificate.
